build_rpn_module: build an RPNModule from config and in_channels to compute region proposals and losses
create_rpn_head: create a SingleConvRPNHead with conv, classification logits, and bbox regression layers
create_rpn_head_conv_regressor: create an RPNHeadConvRegressor with cls_logits and bbox_pred conv layers for anchor prediction
test_rpn_forward_train: test the RPNModule forward training path with anchors, objectness, and targets
review_rpn_forward_test: review the RPNModule forward test path that returns sorted boxes by objectness score
